title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 212
paragraphs: When these words were reported to him, Cyrus made no account of them; and the son of the queen Tomyris, Spargapises, when the wine left him and he learned in what evil case he was, entreated Cyrus that he might be loosed from his chains and gained his request; and then, as soon as he was loosed and had got power over his hands, he put himself to death.
